name: Block starts and short drives
coaching_cues: Aggressive push out of the blocks; stay low through the drive; strike under the hip

name: Hill repeats 60-100m
coaching_cues: Lean from the ankles into the hill; powerful arm drive; full push through the ground

name: Block starts to 30-40m
coaching_cues: Own the first three steps; gradual rise, no standing up at 10m; relaxed shoulders

name: Sled or harness pulls + free sprints
coaching_cues: Resisted reps should look like sprinting, not marching; free reps right after feel the contrast

name: Fly runs (20m build + fly zone)
coaching_cues: Tall and relaxed in the fly zone; fast turnover without reaching; front-side mechanics

name: Ins-and-outs 30-30-30
coaching_cues: Blast-float-blast: float means hold speed with less effort, not slow down; re-attack the last 30

name: Light fly runs or block starts
coaching_cues: Sharp, not exhausting; stop while it still feels fast; nothing to failure this phase

name: Short speed endurance 120-150m
coaching_cues: Fast but controlled off the turn; hold form as fatigue builds; finish tall

name: Split runs 120m + 80m
rest: 60-90 sec inside set, 8 min between sets
coaching_cues: Second rep starts tired on purpose; re-accelerate instead of surviving

name: Speed endurance fast 150m
coaching_cues: Race effort with discipline; the last 50m is a form test, not a grit test

name: 200m + 120m at race effort
coaching_cues: Run the 200 like a final; the 120 after it teaches finishing under fatigue

name: Light speed endurance 120m
coaching_cues: Smooth 90 percent; if it is not smooth, strides only today

name: 100m accelerations to 90%
coaching_cues: Build through the rep; top speed without strain; low end of the speed endurance ladder

name: 300m build-ups (200m runners)
coaching_cues: Build the rep in thirds; last 100 is controlled aggression; early-phase only for 200m group

name: 8 x 200m fast and relaxed
coaching_cues: Fast and relaxed is the whole point; if form goes, the rep is over

name: Extensive tempo 100s
coaching_cues: Relaxed rhythm; nasal breathing early reps; this builds the base that protects speed days

name: Tempo 100s + low plyos
coaching_cues: Tempo first, plyos after while warm; keep plyo contacts low and springy

name: Fartlek up to 30 min
coaching_cues: Surges are strong strides, not sprints; keep the jog honest between them

name: 400m fartlek reps
coaching_cues: Each 400 mixes walk, jog, stride, and a sprint 100; smooth transitions, no hero reps

name: 100m race modeling: blocks to 60m
coaching_cues: Drive 0-30, transition 30-60; rehearse the race in segments, then trust it

name: 200m curve modeling: blocks to 80-120m
coaching_cues: Attack the curve with lean; lane discipline is a skill, practice it; float, do not force

name: Broken runs (200 / jog / 200)
rest: jog across the field between segments
coaching_cues: Second fast segment starts on tired legs like a real final; variants: 300+jog+100, 100+jog+300

name: 150m race simulations
coaching_cues: 100m push, 50m power; this is the 200m race in miniature

name: Pre-meet primer: light starts and strides
coaching_cues: Touch speed, do not train it; leave the track feeling fast; mobility after

name: Base weights + circuit
coaching_cues: Moderate loads, clean reps; core and mini-band work in the circuit; build capacity, not soreness

name: Heavy weights (speed phase)
coaching_cues: Heavier but never grinding; bar speed matters; pair with easy tempo for recovery

name: Low-impact plyos
coaching_cues: Quiet landings; spring off the ground, do not sink into it; low contacts in base phase

name: High-impact plyos (power day)
coaching_cues: Only when fresh; quality contacts over quantity; pair with the acceleration day, never the day before speed

name: Active recovery day
reps: easy jog 15-20 min + foam roll + static stretch
coaching_cues: Leave better than you arrived; this day is what makes the high days possible
